newsitem.title: USA: Merrill names heads for equity linked group.
newsitem.headline: Merrill names heads for equity linked group.

text.p: Merrill Lynch and Co Inc has named two executives to jointly head up the firm's Global Equity Linked Origination group.

According to a Merrill internal memo, the two executives, Peter Hoffman and Phil Jones, will head a group comprised of Merrill's convertible origination, equity derivatives for corporates, restricted stock sales and repurchase programs businesses.
Hoffman, a managing director who has been with Merrill since 1986, has occupied a variety of posts in the firm's equity business, including seven years leading its Equity Capital Markets group.

Jones, a managing director in convertibles, joined Merrill in 1993 and has played a leading role in the firm's development of a variety of hybrid securities such as STRYPES (Structured Yield Product Exchangeable for Stock).
